subject.title: WhatsApp: add listen-only / hooks-only mode for inbound messages without agent runs

question: Should OpenClaw support a WhatsApp hooks-only ingestion mode with a fail-closed pre-turn hook and an explicit metadata-only core-persistence guarantee, and if so what plugin claim/failure semantics are the supported contract?
rationale: This introduces a user-facing account or route mode, configuration surface, plugin boundary, and privacy/retention promise; source inspection cannot safely choose those permanent contracts without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor a strict hooks-only contract
options.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned pre-turn mode with fail-closed hook delivery and a documented metadata-only persistence boundary.

options.title: Limit scope to outbound silence
options.body: Keep `readOnly`-style outbound suppression as the supported passive-monitoring feature and decline a no-agent/no-persistence ingestion guarantee.

options.title: Design a generic channel contract first
options.body: Defer WhatsApp implementation until maintainers define a reusable channel-to-plugin ingestion API and retention model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a strict hooks-only contract
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned pre-turn mode with fail-closed hook delivery and a documented metadata-only persistence boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent analysis identifies the exact unresolved ingress and persistence boundary, making them the strongest available routing candidate pending channel-owner confirmation.
